description: A chart over a data range: the first column is the domain (x axis, pie labels), the other columns (or series_columns) the series.

account.description: Which account this writes as: a label from list_accounts (its editors section). Required; writes have no default.

anchor_cell.description: Where the chart's top-left corner sits, e.g. "Sheet1!H2".

data_range.description: A1 range, e.g. "Sheet1!A1:D20", "B:B" or "2:2". No sheet name means the first sheet.

headers.description: Whether the data's first row names the series.

series_columns.description: Column letters to plot, e.g. ["C","E"]. Empty means every column after the first.

spreadsheet_id.description: The spreadsheet's id, or its URL.

name: add_chart
title: Add a chart
